title: What If the NERD Took His CRUSH to the SCHOOL DANCE?
description:
Your crush just asked you to prom. In front of the whole cafeteria. Standing on your lunch table. There is only one problem: it is not a date, it is a job. She needs a partner for the opening waltz, your mom already said yes for you, and you cannot dance. At all.

One week. One living room with the couch moved out. One rule: every time you step on her foot, she gets to ask you a question.

Two questions for the comments:
1) Would you have walked across that gym?
2) What is the worst nickname a crush ever gave you?

Subscribe, because the tango lessons are next.
